zh: 爱丽丝，跑了一下午，累了吧？
en: Alice, you've been running around all afternoon. Tired?

zh: 嗯……我想在树下休息一会儿。
en: Mm... I want to rest under the tree for a bit.

zh: 那就睡吧，我在这里陪着你。
en: Then sleep. I'll stay right here with you.

zh: 只睡一小会儿……就一小会儿……
en: Just a little nap... just a little...
This melody... it feels so familiar.

zh: 我在哪里听过？……想不起来了。
en: Where have I heard it before? ...I can't remember.

zh: 要迟到了，要迟到了！音律乱了，全都跑调了！
en: I'm late, I'm late! The melody's gone wrong, everything is out of tune!
I have to catch up and ask it!

zh: 没有它，我一定会迟到的……
en: Without it, I'll be late for sure...

zh: 你！你有没有看到一块怀表？
en: You! Have you seen a pocket watch?

zh: 那可不是普通的怀表。仙境里的道具，都是无序化的音符，各自拥有奇特的力量。
en: That's no ordinary watch. Every object in Wonderland is a scattered note, and each one holds a strange power.

zh: 那块怀表能让持有者永远不会迟到。
en: That watch makes sure whoever holds it is never late.

zh: 不过，人类是用不了它的。如果你找到了，一定要还给我！
en: But humans can't use it. If you find it, you must give it back to me!

zh: 我是白兔，仙境的节拍守护者——
en: I'm the White Rabbit, keeper of Wonderland's beat—

zh: 能让人永远不迟到的怀表……我想研究一下。
en: A watch that means you're never late... I want to take a closer look.

zh: 这个音符……好像在回应那个洞。
en: This note... it seems to be answering the hole.
Catch up with the talking rabbit

zh: [W A S D] 移动　　[空格] 跳跃
一块发着微光的金色怀表。指针在轻轻颤动，表盘里传出细小的滴答声，好像在等待什么。
en: A faintly glowing golden pocket watch. Its hands tremble gently, and a tiny ticking comes from inside, as if it is waiting for something.

zh: 调律之后得到的音符，散发着温暖的光。它好像在回应某个地方。
en: A note born from tuning, glowing with a warm light. It seems to be answering something, somewhere.

zh: 按 [B] 或点击上方的背包图标，打开背包
en: Press [B] or click the bag icon at the top to open your bag

zh: 刚才路边好像有什么东西在发光……要不要回去看看？
en: Something was glowing by the path back there... maybe I should go back and look.

zh: 按 [B] 打开背包，点击怀表的【调律】
en: Press [B] to open your bag, then click [Tune] on the watch
Take a closer look at the watch

zh: 点击片段试听，把它们拖到下方音轨上，按你喜欢的顺序排列
en: Click a piece to hear it. Drag the pieces onto the lower track, in any order you like.

zh: 两条音轨对齐了。点击【确认】
en: The two tracks line up. Click [Confirm].
